script: Retail Credit Risk Scoring - Script and Protocols.md

lines.head: A loan can be decided in minutes, with checks around it.
lines.sup: We follow one loan from a phone to the board room.

lines.setting: At home, in the banking app
lines.head: Nadia needs a small loan to replace her broken-down car.
lines.sup: She applies in her banking app after a late shift.

lines.head: Checking loans by hand takes days.
lines.sup: Some applicants give up, and two staff can judge one file in two ways.

lines.head: The model reads her credit file and how she uses her account.
lines.sup: It never uses data on health, religion or race.
lines.source: AI Canvas: Data Strategy, Objective Function

lines.head: It estimates how likely she is to fall 90 days behind on her loan.
lines.sup: If she can afford less, her risk score can never go down.
lines.source: AI Canvas: Objective Function, Modeling Approach

lines.head: Then an underwriter checks the score and the three main reasons for it.
lines.sup: That evening, Nadia's app tells her the answer is no.

lines.head: Next morning Nadia calls to ask why, but the agent sees no reasons.
lines.sup: The reasons stayed in the scoring system and never reached the agent's screen.
lines.source: Incident log: a decline with no reasons

lines.head: After the June rate change, approvals drift by four points.
lines.sup: Between quarterly retrains, a shift like this can go unseen.
lines.source: Incident log and risk register: model drift

lines.head: A fairness test flags one group of applicants for a closer look.
lines.sup: Its approval rate is below four-fifths of the highest group's rate.

lines.head: The agent's screen must show the reasons, so they can be read back.
lines.sup: Nadia can ask an underwriter to look at her case again.
lines.source: Controls: reasons on screen, human review

lines.head: A weekly check is planned to catch drift and unfair results between retrains.
lines.sup: A new model runs in the shadow before it can replace the old one.
lines.source: Planned control; AI Canvas: Model Training

lines.head: The bank re-weights that group and tests again before the scale decision.
lines.sup: Progress is checked every 30 days, with the fairness test on file.
lines.source: Board decision, with evidence on file

lines.head: Answers should come fast, with reasons people can read and challenge.
lines.sup: Next gate: the board decides whether the pilot can scale.
